objects.query: SELECT Code, DataType, Description, Id, Name, Status, UnitOfMeasureId FROM AttributePicklist WHERE Name LIKE 'VEL_%' ORDER BY Name ASC
SELECT Abbreviation, Code, DisplayValue, Id, IsDefault, Name, PicklistId, Sequence, Status, Value FROM AttributePicklistValue WHERE Code LIKE 'VEL_%' ORDER BY Code ASC

SELECT Code, DataType, DefaultHelpText, DefaultValue, Description, DeveloperName, Id, IsActive, IsRequired, Label, Name, PicklistId, SourceSystemIdentifier, UnitOfMeasureId, ValueDescription FROM AttributeDefinition WHERE Code LIKE 'ATTR-VEL-%' ORDER BY Code ASC
SELECT Code, Description, Id, Name FROM AttributeCategory WHERE Code LIKE 'VEL_%' ORDER BY Code ASC

SELECT AttributeCategoryId, AttributeDefinitionId, Id, AttributeCategory.Code, AttributeDefinition.Code FROM AttributeCategoryAttribute WHERE AttributeCategory.Code LIKE 'VEL_%' ORDER BY AttributeCategory.Code ASC, AttributeDefinition.Code ASC
SELECT Code, Id, Name, ParentProductClassificationId, Status FROM ProductClassification WHERE Code LIKE 'VEL_%' ORDER BY Code ASC

SELECT AttributeCategory.Code, AttributeDefinition.Code, ProductClassification.Code, AttributeNameOverride, DefaultValue, Description, DisplayType, HelpText, Id, IsHidden, IsPriceImpacting, IsReadOnly, IsRequired, MaximumCharacterCount, MaximumValue, MinimumCharacterCount, MinimumValue, Name, Sequence, Status, StepValue, UnitOfMeasure.UnitCode, ValueDescription FROM ProductClassificationAttr WHERE ProductClassification.Code LIKE 'VEL_%' ORDER BY ProductClassification.Code ASC, AttributeDefinition.Code ASC

SELECT BasedOnId, CanRamp, ConfigureDuringSale, Description, DisplayUrl, Family, Id, IsActive, IsAssetizable, IsSoldOnlyWithOtherProds, Name, ProductCode, QuantityUnitOfMeasure, SpecificationType, StockKeepingUnit, Type, UnitOfMeasureId FROM Product2 WHERE StockKeepingUnit LIKE 'VEL-%' ORDER BY StockKeepingUnit ASC

SELECT AttributeCategory.Code, AttributeDefinition.Code, AttributeNameOverride, DefaultValue, Description, DisplayType, HelpText, Id, IsHidden, IsPriceImpacting, IsReadOnly, IsRequired, MaximumCharacterCount, MaximumValue, MinimumCharacterCount, MinimumValue, Name, Product2.StockKeepingUnit, ProductClassificationAttribute.Name, Sequence, Status, StepValue, UnitOfMeasure.UnitCode, ValueDescription FROM ProductAttributeDefinition WHERE Product2.StockKeepingUnit LIKE 'VEL-%' ORDER BY Product2.StockKeepingUnit ASC, AttributeDefinition.Code ASC

SELECT DoesAutoRenewAssetByDefault, Id, Name, PricingTerm, PricingTermUnit, SellingModelType, Status FROM ProductSellingModel WHERE Name IN ('One-Time', 'Evergreen Monthly', 'Term Annual') ORDER BY Name ASC, SellingModelType ASC
SELECT ArePartialPeriodsAllowed, Id, Name, ProrationPolicyType, RemainderStrategy FROM ProrationPolicy WHERE Name = 'Default Proration Policy'

SELECT Id, IsDefault, Product2Id, ProductSellingModelId, ProrationPolicyId, Product2.StockKeepingUnit, ProductSellingModel.Name, ProductSellingModel.SellingModelType FROM ProductSellingModelOption WHERE Product2.StockKeepingUnit LIKE 'VEL-%' ORDER BY Product2.StockKeepingUnit ASC, ProductSellingModel.Name ASC
SELECT AssociatedProductRoleCat, Id, MainProductRoleCat, Name FROM ProductRelationshipType WHERE Name = 'Bundle to Bundle Component Relationship' ORDER BY Name ASC

SELECT Code, Description, Id, MaxBundleComponents, MinBundleComponents, Name, ParentGroup.Code, ParentProduct.StockKeepingUnit, Sequence FROM ProductComponentGroup WHERE Code LIKE 'PCG-VEL-%' ORDER BY ParentProduct.StockKeepingUnit ASC, Code ASC

SELECT ChildProductClassification.Code, ChildProduct.StockKeepingUnit, ChildProductRole, DoesBundlePriceIncludeChild, Id, IsComponentRequired, IsDefaultComponent, IsQuantityEditable, MaxQuantity, MinQuantity, ParentProduct.StockKeepingUnit, ParentProductRole, ProductComponentGroup.Code, ProductRelationshipType.Name, Quantity, QuantityScaleMethod, QuoteVisibility, Sequence, UnitOfMeasure.UnitCode FROM ProductRelatedComponent WHERE ParentProduct.StockKeepingUnit LIKE 'VEL-%' ORDER BY ChildProductClassification.Code ASC, ChildProduct.StockKeepingUnit ASC, ParentProduct.StockKeepingUnit ASC, ProductComponentGroup.Code ASC, ProductRelationshipType.Name ASC
SELECT CatalogType, Code, Description, EffectiveEndDate, EffectiveStartDate, Id, Name FROM ProductCatalog WHERE Code = 'VEL' ORDER BY Code ASC
SELECT CatalogId, Code, Description, Id, IsNavigational, Name, ParentCategoryId, SortOrder FROM ProductCategory WHERE Code LIKE 'VEL_%' ORDER BY Catalog.Code ASC, Name ASC

SELECT CatalogId, Id, IsPrimaryCategory, ProductCategoryId, ProductId, ProductCategory.Code, Product.StockKeepingUnit FROM ProductCategoryProduct WHERE Product.StockKeepingUnit LIKE 'VEL-%' ORDER BY ProductCategory.Code ASC, Product.StockKeepingUnit ASC
